title: Car shakes when braking

causes.text: Vibration in brake pedal or steering wheel when braking is a sign of needed brake service
Normal: ABS operation may cause vibration through body/steering and pedal pulsation
causes.document: 2022 Toyota Camry Owner's Manual OM06244U (year mapping per Helm listing; manual is Camry-specific)

urgency.text: Listed brake warning sign: vibration — brakes should be inspected; do not postpone needed repair to the metal-to-metal point.
urgency.document: Car Care Council, "Stop and Check Your Brakes" (Brake Safety Awareness Month, published 2020-08-03; non-profit consumer education organization)

guidancePrimary: universal: Car Care Council — vibration when braking is a listed brake warning sign requiring inspection; Toyota notes ABS activation can normally cause pedal/body vibration (vehicle-specific)

guidance.text: Vibration is listed among the brake warning signs — along with noise, pulling, low or hard pedal feel, grabbing, and an illuminated brake warning light — that mean the brakes should be inspected.
guidance.document: Car Care Council, "Stop and Check Your Brakes" (Brake Safety Awareness Month, published 2020-08-03; non-profit consumer education organization)
guidance.answers: can_i_keep_driving: vibration when braking is a listed brake warning sign — have the brakes inspected promptly

guidance.text: ABS activation can normally cause vibration through the body and steering wheel and pulsation in the brake pedal.
guidance.document: 2022 Toyota Camry Owner's Manual OM06244U (year mapping per Helm listing; manual is Camry-specific)
guidance.appliesTo: vehicle-specific: Toyota Camry 2022; ABS activation only
guidance.answers: vehicle-specific: Toyota notes ABS operation can normally cause pedal/body vibration — not every shake is a fault

firstStep.text: Note when the shake happens: Toyota's manual says ABS activation (hard braking or slippery surfaces) can normally cause body/steering vibration and pedal pulsation. Shaking during ordinary braking is a listed warning sign — have the brakes inspected.
firstStep.document: 2022 Toyota Camry Owner's Manual OM06244U (year mapping per Helm listing; manual is Camry-specific)
firstStep.appliesTo: vehicle-specific: Toyota Camry 2022; ABS activation only
firstStep.answers: check yourself first: compare with ABS activation conditions; ordinary-braking shake = inspect
